paths.path_title: AWS DevOps Engineer — Entry-Level AWS Operations
paths.learner_scope: Career-entry learners progressing to routine entry/junior AWS DevOps operations within approved environment and security boundaries. General computer literacy is required at entry. Prior Linux, networking or programming experience is not necessary to begin external preparation, but that preparation must be completed before dependent native tiles; this is not a self-contained beginner Linux/networking/programming curriculum. The entry-level career-readiness claim and every exit capability are conditional on both the required shared preparation and this path's native AWS operational learning. Preserve binding reuse of the immutable registry's reserved status-planned shared foundation ids: planned means reserved, not delivered or proven learned. Do not recreate those foundations here or imply an unfinished skill path already supplies them. Require external completion or demonstrated equivalent mastery before dependent tiles; if unavailable, the learner cannot progress through those tiles or claim career readiness. Required shared Linux preparation includes filesystem/files, permissions/ownership/users, processes/services, package management, shell pipes/redirection/environment variables and key-based remote access. In particular, linux.filesystem_navigation_and_files, linux.permissions_ownership_and_users and linux.processes_and_services precede dependent Linux configuration validation/restoration tasks; linux.shell_pipes_and_redirection precedes dependent fleet tasks; supplied-Bash execution and exit-status failure detection are deferred, and linux.package_management precedes dependent patch/configuration work. Required shared networking preparation includes networking.ip_addressing_and_cidr before VPC CIDR allocation/routing, plus DNS resolution, HTTP/HTTPS exchanges and TCP/UDP ports/firewall reasoning before dependent diagnosis or access-control work. Docker, testing, access-control/secrets, declarative desired-state/JSON-YAML configuration and cloud compute/object-storage basics likewise use reserved shared preparation before dependent AWS tasks. Reuse active Python language, Git/version-control, systematic debugging, code-review and conceptual pipeline-stage coverage through registry prerequisites rather than duplicating it. These external foundations are outside the 128 resolved native concepts, not supplied exercise scaffolding and not waived because skill paths are unfinished. Native learning applies them to bounded AWS provisioning, Linux service configuration validation/restoration with supplied rollback files, VPC paths, delivery, fleet operations and diagnosis. Linux configuration backup creation and boot-startup policy configuration are deferred. Own CodePipeline/CodeBuild/CodeDeploy and GitHub Actions delivery, CloudWatch logs/metrics, verified alarms, IAM, operational security, recovery and cost controls. Scaling outcomes cover EC2 Auto Scaling and capacity-versus-availability decisions only. ECS service operation covers fixed desired-count reconciliation after task removal, not load-driven changes to desired count; defer load-driven ECS scaling, serverless concurrency and RDS/DynamoDB capacity selection. Also defer Jenkins/GitLab, X-Ray/request tracing, service-dashboard construction, WAF deployment, independent general-purpose Bash control-flow authoring, persistent-storage product selection, managed-secret rotation and workload cost estimation. Supplied tests, existing lab infrastructure, parameters or ready SDK functions may bound native exercises; they never replace required external foundation mastery. Exclude Azure/GCP, application architecture/API/feature development, data engineering/MLOps, specialist security engineering and self-managed Kubernetes administration. Represent all 22 benchmark families at the bounded competency depth, not professional-certification depth. Preserve the resolved 128-native-concept inventory, excluding reused external foundations: target approximately 130, hard ceiling 150 including atomicity splitting and stage-03 candidates; no family above 10. Registry prerequisites do not count as native concepts. Cut breadth rather than atomicity; no new concepts for this repair.
